system.description: A combination Discipline allowing continuous rapid overland travel on foot without the exhausting effects of combat Celerity use. You may reduce out-of-game travel times by a factor equal to the number of Celerity powers you possess. Each hour (or fraction thereof) of travel costs a number of Blood Traits equal to half the number of Celerity powers you have. You may use this power a maximum number of times per night equal to the number of Fortitude powers you possess. It is of no benefit in combat. Costs 6 Experience Traits to learn.
system.bloodCost: Half the number of Celerity powers possessed, per hour of travel
